segments: here is why I don't celebrate New Year's
Americans are likely to think that New
Year's Eve and New Year's Day is a time
to celebrate but did you know that in
the black community New Year's day was
known as hiring day or heartbreak day
this was a hering time when enslavers
would settle deaths by trading black
lives and labor New Year's Eve wasn't a
celebration for the enslaved but a night
of anxious waiting filled with the dread
of whether they or their loved ones
would be torn away to be auctioned off
the slaves would pray that their owners
